notes: Copy this file to drive/spotify_aoty_listen/config.json (drive/ is gitignored). Genre tags are matched case-insensitively against AOTY listing labels (any overlap). Known typo ost-Punk Revival is normalized to Post-Punk Revival. Save AOTY highest-rated pages via browser Save Page As (HTML) into drive/spotify_aoty_listen/pages/ — any *.html title works (sorted by 'Page N'; page 1 has no Page label). max_pages keeps pages 1..N only; sync also auto-raises max_pages to the highest Page N found in pages/ (capped at 20) so an older config with max_pages=6 still ingests all saved pages. Cloudflare blocks curl.
